oracle-l5r-8138: The Honor of the Lion (Strategy): its Focus Effect, "You may choose (now) to delay the effects of losing this duel until after the next Dynasty Phase begins", needs the shared delay mechanism (Mendon 2026-09-24: cards that delay effects, actions or a phase are to be built together by Mendon and the coordinator, not card by card): Dueling.cs applies a duel's outcome as one indivisible case per duel-issuing ability (ApplyDuelOutcome) plus each focused card's own loss-keyed traits, and the only deferral the engine has is DelayedDestruction.cs's delay-destroy kind (one destruction put off until the turn ends), not the bows, moves home, Honor/Gold losses, penalties and tokens that are also consequences of losing. It needs a per-duel queue of the loser's consequences, drained when the next Dynasty Phase begins (SetPhase(Phase.Dynasty) is the hook). The Battle/Open half is separately wirable with what exists and was checked: "Choose your performing unbowed honorable Lion Clan Personality: Permanently give him a bonus raising his PH to 4 and the ability, 'Battle: Target an enemy Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor: Bow him. Gain 2 Honor.'" is a permanent PersonalHonor modifier (AddPermanentModifier, set to 4 from his current value), a permanent granted ability (GrantAbility, GrantDuration.Permanent) with a small new Target category (an enemy Personality with equal or lower Personal Honor than the source, the holder; enemy-personality-honor-lt-source is the strictly-lower sibling), and the honorable/unbowed Lion Clan performer category (HasClanAffiliation + MatchesTargetStatus(IsHonorable)) -- so the card would be wired whole the moment the delay mechanism exists.
